pipeline_params.description: Per-model difficulty heads: a linear head over frozen sentence embeddings plus structural features estimates P(correct | query, model) for each candidate, and the router picks argmax of that probability minus a cost penalty. Trained on 27 public datasets audited SHA-256 exact plus MinHash near-duplicate against all 9,613 RouterArena evaluation questions at zero overlap, with per-model correctness measured by us. Pool and cost weight selected on a disjoint split of that corpus. No RouterArena prompt, answer, label or outcome informs any parameter.
